Sanitary Sewer Rehabilitation
Sanitary Sewer Repairs

Starting Date: Weather permitting, Monday November 2,
2026.
Description of Work Activities: The City of Ames has
contracted with Municipal Pipe Tool, LLC. to perform repairs
to the sanitary sewer system in the area. The purpose of this
work is to repairs aging infrastructure and reduce the risk of
sanitary sewer backups. You may notice utility flags as the
underground utilities are located prior to construction

Starting Monday November 2nd, Municipal Pipe Tool and
its subcontractors will begin construction activities at the
intersection of E 13th St and Dayton Ave. Work will include
repairing deficient sections of sanitary sewer and
rehabilitating deteriorated manholes. This work will
require lane closures on both E 13th St and Dayton
Ave. Further notices will be delivered as construction
proceeds.
Anticipated Duration: The contractor is anticipating 10 to
14 days for this lane closure.
Action Required by Residents: No action is required at
this time. Please review the anticipated project limit on back
of this page. All are encouraged to take note of this
construction activity in the area and allow extra travel
time as delays may occur. As always, caution should be
exercised when traveling through the construction area.
